title: CVE-2026-126793 - Privilege escalation in Aurora PostgreSQL dialect detection in AWS Advanced Go Wrapper
description:
CVE-2026-126793 - Privilege escalation in Aurora PostgreSQL dialect detection in AWS Advanced Go Wrapper
Bulletin ID:
2026-182-AWS
Scope:
AWS
Content Type:
Important (requires attention)
Publication Date:
11/12/2026 13:00 PM PST
Description:
AWS Advanced Go Wrapper is an open source Go database driver wrapper that customers use to connect to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL clusters.
We identified
CVE-2026-126793
, an issue in Aurora PostgreSQL dialect detection in AWS Advanced Go Wrapper from release 2026-04-06 (awssql/v2.0.0) and before release 2026-07-29 (awssql/v2.0.3). An authenticated database user who can create functions in a schema on another database user's search path might escalate privileges to those of that user, including a member of the rds_superuser role, when that user connects to an Aurora PostgreSQL cluster through an affected version of the wrapper.
Impacted versions:
>= 2026-04-06 AND < 2026-07-29 (awssql/v2 >= 2.0.0 AND < 2.0.3)
Resolution:
This issue has been addressed in
AWS Advanced Go Wrapper release 2026-07-29 (awssql/v2.0.3)
, released on July 29, 2026. We recommend upgrading to the latest version and ensuring any forked or derivative code is patched to incorporate the new fixes.
Workarounds:
If you cannot upgrade immediately, revoke the CREATE privilege on the public schema from PUBLIC (REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;), and grant CREATE on any other schema in the search_path of database users that connect through AWS Advanced Go Wrapper only to trusted database users.
